title: Reply to an Item thread and resolve it
preconditions: Use pr-7 table/node with no comments.

steps.action: Add a root comment asking Is there an index on status? and save its returned ID.
steps.expected_result: The table report has one comment and one open thread.

steps.action: Reply to that ID with Added in the migration and resolve.
steps.expected_result: The same slide has two comments and zero open threads.

steps.action: Inspect the resulting thread and each comment target.
steps.expected_result: The reply joins the root thread and retains its exact table/node context.
